ShareSkills.Title: Power BI Training Course Covering Data Preparation DAX Calculations Interactive Dashboards
ShareSkills.Description: Power BI training course covering data preparation, modeling, and DAX calculations for dashboards. This program includes topics like Power Query, incremental refresh, row level security, and enterprise reporting solutions with real life projects. Students will learn end to end workflows for transforming raw data into actionable insights and publishing reports in the Power BI Service.
